CONSULAR ACCESS WITH FOREIGN
CONSULAR ACCESS WITH FOREIGN
PRISONERS RULES, 2019
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
2nd September, 2019]
No.
SO(R&P)27-63/2019, dated 31.7.2019.---In exercise of the powers conferred by section 59 of the Prisons Act,
1894 (IX of 1894), the [Provincial Government], read with The Diplomatic and
Consular Privileges Act, 1972 (IX of 1972), Governor of the Punjab is pleased
to make the following rules:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1)
These rules may be called the Consular Access with Foreign Prisoners Rules,
2019;
(2) They
extend to the [Province of Punjab];
(3) They
shall come into force at once.
2. Definitions.---(1) In these rules, unless there is anything
repugnant in the subject or context,
a) "consular
officer", shall mean a culy authorized person by the Sending State;
b) "consular
access", shall mean any allowed visit, by the Consular Officer duly
authorized to visit a national of the sending state who is in prison, custody
or detention to converse and correspond with him and to arrange for his legal
representation;
c) "espionage",
shall mean spying for the purpose prejudicial to the safety of or interest of
the State and may include approaches, inspect, passes over or is in the
vicinity of, or enters, any prohibited 'place or makes any sketch, plan, model,
or note which is calculated to be or might be or is intended to be, directly or
indirectly, useful to any enemy or obtains, collects, records or publishes or
communicates to any other person any secret official code or password or any
sketch plan, model, article or note or other document or information which is
calculated to be or might be or is intended to be, directly or indirectly,
useful to any enemy;
d) "foreign
national", shall mean a person who is not a citizen of Pakistan, pursuant
to Pakistan Citizenship Act, 1951;
e) "foreign
prisoner", shall mean any foreign national who has been arrested, is in
prison, custody or detention, under trial, unconfirmed condemned, or confirmed
condemned, or has been duly committed to custody under the writ or order of any
court or competent authority, or under provisions of the Pakistan Army Act,
1952, for the charges of espionage, terrorism, anti-state activities or matters
connected there with or ancillary thereto;
f) "prison",
shall mean a Jail or any other notified place, used permanently or temporarily,
under the general or special orders of the government;
g) "receiving
state", shall mean Pakistan;
h) "sending
state", shall mean the country of nationality of the foreign prisoner;
i) "terrorism",
shall have the meaning ascribed to it under the Anti-Terrorism Act, 1997 and
all other relevant laws of Pakistan;
3. Provisions
of Consular Access.---Consular
access to the foreign inmates shall be subject to the approval/NOC of the
Ministry of Foreign Affairs or the Ministry of Interior, Government of
Pakistan, essentially conveyed to the Inspectorate of Prisons or Superintendent
of Jail concerned through the Home Department Government of Punjab, in the manner as provided
hereafter:
1) No
foreign prisoner shall be allowed to have an interview without prior
permission;
2) No
consular visit shall be permitted if the foreign prisoner confirms, in writing,
before superintendent jail, his or her desire not to avail such consular visit.
4. Manner
of Consular Access.---(1) Consular
access shall take place in the following manner:
a. Each
consular visit shall require a prior written permission as provided for in Rule
3 above, subject to security clearance by concerned authorities at least
forty-eight (48) hours prior to the said consular access;
b. No
more than one (01) consular officer may visit the foreign prisoner, unless
expressly permitted by the concerned authorities of Pakistan, in writing;
c. Duration
of each consular visit shall be determined by the concerned authorities of
Pakistan and shall not exceed thirty (30) minutes, however such time may be
